## Description

Rank earnings announcements by earnings surprise standardized against historical surprises and take long positions in positive surprises.

## Where it may fit

Earnings-announcement drift where information diffuses gradually after reports.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short, event-driven and quantitative stock-selection funds.

## Required data

Actual and consensus EPS, announcement timestamps, point-in-time analyst estimates, price/volume data and corporate actions.

## Caveats

Consensus datasets can be costly; timestamps and point-in-time estimates are essential to avoid look-ahead.
